authority: Derived integration record; upstream source and MPES remain authoritative
policy: Prefer dependency-isolated adapters and upstream-compatible seams over copying an application wholesale.
Every adopted patch or fork must record exact source identity, license, delta, owner, tests, migration path, and exit or upgrade condition.
No upstream code is included in the product until license, provenance, security, bundle, and maintenance review passes.
